<div id="hideContentSub" style="display: none;"></div><noinclude>

==Usage instructions==
Including this template in a page triggers a JavaScript function that hides the link from a subpage to its parent page. For example, this would prevent [[Green/Aura]] automatically linking back to [[Green]] at the top of the page. To use the template, add <nowiki>{{HideContentSub}}</nowiki> to the top of the article page.

==Example==
<pre><nowiki>
{{HideContentSub}}
</nowiki></pre>

[[Category:Utility templates|{{PAGENAME}}]]</noinclude>
